Basics

Apple sauce

Almaszósz

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 4 portions

From 6 months, unsweetened, beside porridge or meat or eaten on its own.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 3 eating apples (peeled and cored)
  • 3 tbsp water (no sugar)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel, core, and chop the apples.
  2. Cook them in the water until they collapse.
  3. Mash until smooth, or leave a soft lump for an older baby.
  4. Cool and use, or freeze in small portions.
  5. Add nothing sweet.

Sound idea

Sugar is often added to apple sauce and it is not needed.

Cook the apple and leave it unsweetened for porridge, meat, or a spoon.
